title: A2-a: a tank that empties completely and refills
body: A vented vessel that drains to zero and refills is kept out of the first dynamics release (TX) by your ADR 0008 answer Q-A5. Until it is admitted, the "vessel drains to zero" rule only covers evacuating a rigid vessel.

options.label: Keep it out of TX's first release; decide when X25 is designed
